pin.longFormSummary:
An operator-announced yakitori and soba restaurant planned for late October 2026 near Osaka-Abenobashi; final menu and opening day remain unpublished.

Estimated: SASAYA official branch page and official brand directory state late October 2026 (令和8年10月末OPEN), without an exact day. October 31 represents October 2026 for sorting and is not a confirmed opening day. Booking calendar instead first permits November 1; that does not establish actual opening. Guide label must show Oct 2026, not October 31. Do not infer that the venue has opened when an estimate passes.

menus.note: Deep search checked exact operator branch announcement and menu/interior gallery, owner brand directory, exact branch Hot Pepper home/food/drink/gallery/seat-only booking, linked Tabelog and menu, operator recruitment, and image search. Owner has only a generic Coming soon gallery placeholder and no named dishes/prices yet. Hot Pepper inherited predecessor Ryo copy: salmon/roe kamameshi ¥2,178 and thigh-basket grill headline ¥1,518 versus body ¥1,669; these are not verified Hiyori launch items and are excluded rather than borrowed. Drink page failed download; Tabelog direct fetch blocked and indexed page has no edited menu/photos. Generic image search returns unrelated soba/yakitori businesses, all excluded. No new-branch menu PDF, ordering menu, published promotion or current installation photo found. Actual launch dishes/prices, direct phone, exact service start date, final name and new fit-out photographs remain specific research gaps. No sister-store menu or unlabelled food-photo identities invented. Existing photo listing retains Ryo-era material and cannot establish Hiyori fit-out; no image assigned. Provisional name explicitly retained. Owner confirms late October 2026 only; booking calendar is closed through October 31 and available from November 1, which is not proof of opening on either date. Do not silently resolve that conflict or mark open. Owner planned hours 17:00–04:00 (food last order03:00, drinks03:30) differ from inherited booking18:00–05:00(food04:00/drinks04:30). Operator hours shown as planned pending verification.
